# extract code ending with terminal type switch -> covers isTerm TypeSwitchStmt path
mv F:/BEGIN/+0,/END/-0 New
-- x.go --
package p

var v any

func F() int {
	// BEGIN
	x := 1
	switch v.(type) {
	case int:
		println(x)
		return 1
	default:
		println(x)
		return 0
	}
	// END
}
-- stdout --

+	// END
